meta.title: Artel
meta.description: Run a development task in an isolated copy of your project: one agent on its own, three agents sharing one copy and dividing the files first, a conductor leading the team — the workers propose the shares, the conductor approves the layout and accepts the finished work — a Fusion run where three models answer the same question independently, a judge merges their answers into one decision and one model implements it — or an Orchestrator run where a planner splits a large goal into independent parts, each part is worked in its own copy and checked by a reviewer against the plan's done conditions, and a part that fails goes back to work and never reaches you. Accepted parts are assembled into one copy, with a merger deciding the files several parts changed. Watch the live feed of full agent replies, review the diff line by line, then apply the result or discard it. Pick the provider, model and reasoning effort for the run (including a separate route for each Fusion slot), and reroute any single agent while it works. Queue tasks in the unattended Auto-queue and they run at night without you — each saved as its own version, the project's checks run themselves and anything doubtful is set aside — or open the Factory, a ticket board where agents carry a request through triage, work, tests, checks and review to a ready pull request. Open Artel with the button next to the chat composer.
